about.title: About Ohana
about.body1: At Ohana we believe a wedding is the most honest expression of a love story. That's why we work side by side with every couple, from the first conversation to the last toast.
about.body2: Our team combines years of experience in luxury event planning with a warm, minimalist aesthetic sensibility, always in service of your vision.
about.quote: Ohana means family, and that's how we treat every project.
